name: Guangdong Tianyu Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Tianyu Semiconductor Co., Ltd. designs, develops, produces and markets semiconductor materials and SiC (silicon carbide) epitaxial wafers through subsidiaries, selling to mainland China, Hong Kong and South Korea. Wafers are available in 4-, 6- and 8-inch sizes, with services including epitaxial foundry and wafer cleaning.
